mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point decline in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE decline >0.3pp in 3 months), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS > 380,000) and housing starts (HOUST > 550) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 380000 and HOUST > 550, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 130,000) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the labor market remains healthy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.0 point decline in industrial production over one month signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO decline >1.0 in 1 month), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
